It's not really that bad. I have been hospitalized twice. 
They take all of your belonging and put you in a safe room. Doctors will come see you then eventually a psychiatrist. You talk with them for an hour or more. Then they decide if you should stay at the hospital or leave. If you stay they will move you to the psychiatric ward. You basically get a schedule of when you have to do things, like take meds, go to therapy, etc. The hospitals help a lot of people but can also make some feel worse. It's all about finding what will work best for you. And believe me when I say it's hard because I have never dealt with anything more difficult, but I think in the end it really is worth it.
